title: UFO Caught on Video? 'Mystery' Object Appears on SpaceX Starship Livestream, Grok Dismisses Alien Theories
description: During SpaceX's historic Starship orbital flight, a mysterious blue streak on the livestream sparked viral UFO theories on X (formerly Twitter). Experts and Grok clarified it was residual exhaust gas from the booster, not an alien spacecraft. Neither SpaceX nor CEO Elon Musk issued a statement regarding the mysterious object captured during the broadcast.
